semantics.field_position_yardline_100: Observed punt snap yardline_100; yards from kicking team's goal line.
semantics.gross_distance_yards: Observed nflverse kick_distance statistic; not a landing coordinate.
semantics.return_yards: Observed nflverse return_yards statistic; zero when source records zero.
semantics.touchdown_and_scoring_team: Observed touchdown flag and scoring side derived from posteam/defteam score deltas on the punt row.
semantics.final_spot_yardline_100: For non-scoring punts, next-series restart-spot proxy from the observed first-down scrimmage yardline_100, relative to the team in possession; may include enforcement before that snap and is not a structured dead-ball spot. Not applicable after a punt touchdown.
semantics.landing_and_recovery: Structured landing/recovery coordinates are absent from this source; both remain estimated_unresolved.
semantics.possession_after: Observed from the next series' offense, relative to the kicking and receiving teams.
semantics.sampling: Sample complete event rows jointly after field-position bin selection; never derive final spot from gross distance.
